problem.title: Longest Subarray of Ones After Deleting One Element
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary array, delete exactly one element and determine the maximum length of a contiguous subarray containing only 1s after the deletion.
problem.input: • First line contains N. • Second line contains N binary integers.
